summary: The classifier now gives every closed preparation deferral a closed refusal reason, so a pass that leaves ready work unplanned because of a failed state write is no longer silent, and the fake-port regression drives the real planner result through the diagnostic, finalize and watchdog to show the measured count falls from 1 to 0 under the unchanged limit. No defects found in the exact diff.

evidence: `src/host/matrix-plan-refusal.ts` now maps every closed preparation deferral other than bounds and reservation denials, including state_error, blocked, artifact, deferred and other, to target_unavailable instead of leaving the refusal null.

`tests/host/matrix-plan-refusal_test.ts` stubs the state port to unavailable, runs planMatrixWave against a ready record, and asserts refusal target_unavailable with readyUnplanned 1 and no reservation.

The same test carries that real planner diagnostic through scanPlanDiagnostic, finalize metrics and evaluateThroughputWatchdogV1: measured is 0 with the unchanged limit, while the same record with a null refusal measures 1 as missed.

After restoring the state port the regression shows the same ready task is admitted on the next wave without the failed pass rewriting counters or settling a reservation, and no throughput threshold file is changed.
